item.title: Apple's MacBook Pro DFU port documentation is wrong
item.description:
📝 If you're using a Mac with Apple silicon, plug your storage device into any compatible port except the DFU port. If you’re using any other Mac, plug your storage device into any compatible port. At no point did it ever say, hey, plug your disk into a different port.
🔗 Read more: https://lapcatsoftware.com/articles/2026/2/1.html

item.title: Leaked Chats Expose the Daily Life of a Scam Compound's Enslaved Workforce
item.description:
📝 He Leaked the Secrets of a Southeast Asian Scam Compound. They struggled to meet scam revenue quotas to avoid fines that deepened their debt. ”“It’s terrifying, because it’s manipulation and coercion,” says Sims, who studies Southeast Asian scam compounds.
